defaults.estimator: custom normal-theory maximum likelihood; scipy.optimize L-BFGS-B plus Fisher scoring refinement
defaults.standard_errors: expected normal information with c_g multipliers
defaults.variance_constraints: unbounded covariance and residual parameters; implied covariance must be positive definite; inadmissibility reported
defaults.V4_hash_format: numeric ascending order, integral values in decimal without .0, UTF-8 newline separators, no terminal newline
defaults.nonfinite_output: JSON null; model errors and inadmissibility reported separately
defaults.weighted_model_covariance: normalize sample weights to n, then divide weighted cross products by n-1
defaults.FIML_saturated: unrestricted MVN EM; maximum 20000 iterations; maximum absolute moment change <1e-10
defaults.FIML_SRMR: unrestricted saturated normal ML covariance from EM; nominal group n weighting
defaults.FIML_d_obs: unit-weighted scores require all items in a factor; SD skips undefined scores (pandas-style skipna default); those sample hashes are reported
defaults.fit_index_conventions: manifest formulas; mean residuals excluded from SRMR; ordinary unscaled indices and differences
